Product Details: Waxpol Conservation Wax Polish is a one-of-a-kind combination of Microcrystalline Wax Polish that is mixed with refined waxes derived from the refining process of crude oil. This unique blend has the ability to enhance, restore, revive, and protect a wide range of fine art objects, furniture, wood, leather, paintings, metals, marble, stones, ceramics, and ivory, among others. Not only does it bring out the vibrancy of colors, but it also imparts a soft sheen to the surfaces it is applied on. Additionally, it forms a durable, transparent film that adds an attractive luster and offers high resistance against moisture, finger marking, environmental pollution, abrasion, and weathering when used in exposed locations.
